description: Na₄Mg(BiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.49 Å. Mg is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.07 Å. Bi is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Bi₂ square pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mg atom.
